notes: One in-scope unit: School of Communication, Ph.D. in Communication (research doctorate, emphases in health/interpersonal/organizational communication). name: University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee
notes: Single in-scope unit: Department of Communication (PhD in Communication). UWM also has a School of Information Studies (PhD in Information Studies) and Journalism, Advertising & Media Studies dept (JAMS), but neither grants a communication/media PhD; JAMS offers no doctorate and SOIS is library/information science, so excluded.

notes: Two in-scope units in the College of Liberal Arts, each with its own research PhD: Communication Studies (Ph.D. in Communication) and Journalism & Media Communication (Ph.D. in Media Communication). notes: UH Manoa has no standalone Communication PhD; the research doctorate is the interdisciplinary CIS PhD (hawaii.edu/cis), jointly sponsored by SCI's Communication/Communicology programs, Information and Computer Sciences, IT Management (Shidler), and Library and Information Science.
